# Ponytail

Use the repository's `.agents/skills/ponytail/SKILL.md` guidance for coding tasks,
at the default `full` level unless the user requests another level or turns it off.
Read that file before making changes. Preserve correctness, validation, error
handling, security, accessibility, and tests; minimize unnecessary code, not scope.

Installed from https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail using
`gh skill install DietrichGebert/ponytail skills/ponytail --agent github-copilot --scope project`.
This is a prompt-based skill, not a background service; no runtime or hooks are needed.
